commands.reason: Erroneous/premature tie-switch closure request while the radial N02-N03-N05 path is still fully closed.

scenario.name: Loop rejection
scenario.description: From the healthy baseline (no prior isolation), the controller asks to close the N02-N05 tie switch while N02-N03 and N03-N05 are still both closed. Closing it would form a closed loop (N02-N03-N05-N02), so PowerPlaneState.apply_command rejects the operation (accepted=false, reason 'rejected: closing line would create a closed-loop LV topology') as long as the pipeline is run with the default preserve_radial=True / without --allow-loops. The PSCAD switch state is left unchanged -- use this run to confirm the safety check holds and no loop current path is ever energized in PSCAD.
